speaker: Doctor
text: I see you had a viral illness 8 weeks ago; has your cough ever improved and then returned, or has it persisted since? Also, have you noticed any specific triggers like dust, pets, or changes in weather that seem to worsen your symptoms?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious Cough Variant Asthma.

Based on your history of a recent viral infection followed by an episodic, nonproductive cough that worsens at night and with exertion, this pattern strongly suggests airway hyperreactivity. Do you have a history of allergies, eczema, or asthma in you or your family members?
